description: This file defines a final class TerminationSignalWatcher that sets up signal handlers for termination signals (SIGTERM and SIGINT) to enable graceful shutdown procedures in a macOS application, including stopping pairing prompts, logging the signal reception, and terminating the app.

classes.name: TerminationSignalWatcher
classes.description: A singleton class that manages Unix signal handling for graceful termination of the application.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts listening for termination signals by installing handlers for SIGTERM and SIGINT.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops listening for signals and cancels all signal sources.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Sets up a signal handler for the given signal number.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles received signals, initiates app termination, and schedules exit.
